name: Hivemind
tag: Ant colonies that find food by following each other's scent trails
title: Hivemind

text.TAG: No ant knows the plan. Each one just follows scent trails, and together they find food, build highways and wage war
text.FREE: Build any world: food, walls, rival nests and weather, with no goals
text.WATCH: A tour of busy colonies: trails, mazes, rival nests and rainstorms
text.FOOT: Searching ants leave a trail that leads home. Ants carrying food leave a trail that leads to food. Others follow the strongest smell.
text.FIND: Find a colony, ant or tool…
text.HINT: Drag to paint · right-drag to look around
